skill.summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common legal services questions. Use when working on FAQ content for legal ops teams, attorneys, compliance teams.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Build Legal Services FAQ Page

- Launches a skill to generate customer-facing answers for common legal services questions.
- Designed for use by legal ops teams, attorneys, and compliance teams to create FAQ content.
- Includes a step-by-step workflow for clarifying requirements and refining drafts.
- Supports relevant SEO keywords for FAQ, legal workflow, and law firm automation.
- Recommends human review prior to delivering or publishing answers.
